title: Reference approach: Transfer Learning
answer: Implement transfer learning in a small isolated script. Required implementation evidence includes: ResNet18_Weights, requires_grad, fc. Use a reproducible seed, report observed output, and explain relevant edge cases.
explanation: This exercise consolidates the topic from lesson 088. The list of required strings is only a minimal static signal; inspect numerical correctness, error handling, and test outcomes manually.
example_code:
import torch
from torch import nn
# Offline-safe transfer-learning pattern; avoids downloading pretrained weights.
backbone=nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(8,16),nn.ReLU());
for p in backbone.parameters(): p.requires_grad=False
head=nn.Linear(16,3); print(all(not p.requires_grad for p in backbone.parameters()), head.out_features)
# For torchvision ResNet18, replace model.fc (not model.classifier).
